goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The demo store has no payment gateway configured: the payment step shows No payment gateway configured and the Pay button stays disabled. That is a setting of the demo, not an accessibility barrier.

After Add to bag the button only says Adding... and then returns; no clear announcement that the item was added. Only the cart button label changed to 1 1 item in cart, view bag (number read twice).
On arriving at checkout, focus sat on the Contact heading and the whole page, including a 252 item country list, was dumped; jumping to First name reported an element with no name once.
Optional fields are named with the word optional twice, e.g. Company (optional)(optional); decorative unnamed images sit before fields; labels were separate text, not clearly tied to inputs.
Order summary says Shipping Free and Total $11.99 while the selected EMS method costs $34.20, so the price shown contradicts the choice until the next step.

Payment step shows No payment gateway configured, and the Pay $46.19 button is disabled, so no way to pay exists; the Free shipping badge in the summary contradicts the $34.20 shipping charge. Also the Continue buttons switch to Saving... and focus is lost to top of page, with the next step announced only via a changed title.
